name: ProducedWaterHaulingTracker
tagline: From pumper call-in to reconciled ticket – SLA-driven dispatch, disposal-site allocations, tank-drop reconciliation and carrier scorecards for produced water hauling.
description: A complete produced-water logistics app in one Power Apps code component: haul requests with urgent and routine SLAs, a dispatch board, haul tickets, deliveries to SWD wells and recycling facilities within their daily allocation, reconciliation of driver tickets against tank drops and disposal meters, haul + disposal cost and a carrier scorecard – for canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Urgent and routine response SLA with overdue alerts
Dispatch board sorted by SLA due time with one-click next steps
Truck capacity check on every load
Approved disposal sites with daily allocation and fee
Ticket vs tank drop and disposal meter variance with tolerance and critical %
One-click reconcile of every ticket within tolerance per lease
Disputes with reasons, cancel and reinstate
Haul + disposal cost per ticket, month to date and per barrel
Carrier scorecard: on-time %, response, transit, variances, disputes, cost/bbl
Bulk reconcile / dispute / cancel, delete with undo, CSV export
Demo mode with fictional Saltgrass Basin data
Phone, tablet and desktop layouts, keyboard and screen-reader support
